title: Spaces, Circles, Channels, Market and Classifieds say "nothing here" with the same empty state as the rest of the app

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-19 design list (30 items), items 28 and 30

detail: Cohesion pass, second cut. The kit index bodies each hand-wrote an `.empty stack` div with no glyph, while Around You, Members, Store and Housing used the shared EmptyState (the kit's `.empty mu-empty` room with its glyph chip). Spaces, Circles, Channels, Market and Classifieds now render EmptyState too: no-results when a filter or search is on, first-use otherwise. Copy is unchanged. Events keeps its own `.ev-empty` with two host CTAs.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];for(const p of ['components/frequency/members/spaces/spaces-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/circles/circles-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/channels/channels-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/marketplace/marketplace-body.tsx']){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(s.includes('className=\"empty stack\"')||!s.includes('<EmptyState'))bad.push(p)}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1036: hand-written empty state in '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when an index body goes back to a hand-written empty div. Behavior is index-empty.test.ts.
